name: Terjemahan Lama
statement: This Bible is in the Public Domain.

verification.note: The sources disagree: SABDA, which distributes the text in Indonesia, marks it copyright (contact YLSA), while CCEL calls the Unbound Bible copy public domain. The 1958 Terjemahan Lama is published by Lembaga Alkitab Indonesia; without a statement from LAI it is not published.
